title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Microsoft Graph APIs for agent and app inventory and details
summary: The inventory and details calls, administrator paths and Agent 365 licence requirement are supported by Microsoft's documentation. The changed service description still supports the add-on licensing model; the page needs minor source additions and the stand-alone subscription qualification.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance guidance: At rollout; Governance controls

claims.where: Governance controls: selected agent and plugin
claims.claim: The admin actions apply to the selected agent and should not be assumed to apply to its entire plugin.
claims.quote: These actions apply to the selected agent. If the agent is included in a plugin, don't assume the action also applies to the whole plugin package, its skills, shared MCP servers, or connections.

claims.where: Governance controls: delegated access
claims.claim: The delegated-only block operation must run on behalf of a signed-in administrator rather than in app-only context.
claims.quote: In delegated access, the app calls Microsoft Graph on behalf of a signed-in user. In app-only access, the app calls Microsoft Graph with its own identity, without a signed-in user.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/permissions-overview to sources for the explanation of delegated versus app-only execution.
